name: Renamon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 Option card with [Plug-In] in its name and 1 yellow Tamer among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you use an Option card with a memory cost of 2 or more, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
